The document verification screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Summary of what was built:
- Four document cards (ID proof, address proof, bank statement, photo), each with an icon, description, status badge (not uploaded / under review / approved / rejected), a rejection reason shown via an `Alert` when applicable, and a `FileUpload` control for uploading or replacing the file.
- An overall progress `ProgressBar` showing how many of the four documents are approved, with a caption.
- Mock data covers all four states out of the box (approved, under review, rejected with reason, not uploaded), and selecting/replacing a file moves that document to "under review" and clears any prior rejection reason.
- Built entirely with `@strata/react` components and `@strata/icons`, using logical CSS properties so it works across brands, color schemes, and the RTL locale.
